outOfScope: Global scheduler, role registry or organization workflow graph.
Exactly-once event transport or transactional outbox as a correctness prerequisite.
Deployment, AcceptanceSnapshot or Product QA semantics.
Execution-policy or strategy selection inside the activation boundary.
constraints: Event or queue delivery is not lifecycle, claim or execution authority.
Activation is not strategy selection and is not obligation creation.
Queue, cursor and local backoff state are disposable and reconstructable from canonical work state.
A stale queued hint cannot resurrect invalidated work.
Frontend and Backend independence is governed by exact semantic dependencies, not global development stages.
A durable runtime such as Restate may host activation mechanics but cannot become organizational source of truth or hidden scheduler.
invariants: one domain outage must not block unrelated domain work
queued stale hints cannot resurrect invalidated work
architectureDecisions: Activation is level-triggered per owning domain; hints/scans only discover exact work and canonical state is reread before claim.
Key={projectId,workId,owningDomain}; trigger data grants no principal/claim/strategy/runtime/obligation/publication authority.
Canonical scans are recovery truth; disposable hint state cannot strand work; duplicates converge through claim/release + attempt currentness.
BB-052 owns obligation currentness plus canonical work invalidation/release fencing; BB-053 consumes that truth read-only and returns to RESEARCH_SA if the delivered contract drifts.
DomainExecutionInput is immutable content-addressed execution data; exactly one ref must match WorkContract owningDomain/workloadType.
DomainExecutionController resolves policy/strategy and passes exact WorkContract to its prebound adapter; activation never selects HOW.
BACKEND/FRONTEND have separate principals, hosts, controllers and adapters; shared stores provide CAS/currentness only.

Activation rereads the exact obligation subject+revision after release and before DomainExecutionController.execute; drift blocks execution with no attempt, while BB-052 remains owner of canonical invalidation/fencing.
Parallel proof requires both FE/BE dispatch entered before either completes; host-local failure and exact invalidation cannot affect siblings.
implementationSlices: D1 — DomainExecutionInput [AC-5,AC-6]. Files: domain-execution-input.js, organization-artifact-store.js, index.js. API: immutable v1 {owningDomain,workloadType,repository,requiredFiles,constraints}, content-addressed put/resolve, resolveWorkExecutionInput(contract). Require exactly one matching requiredArtifactRef; zero/multiple/mismatch fails pre-dispatch. Tests: frontend-domain, fe-be-parallel.

D2 — Controller seam [AC-2,AC-3,AC-4,INV-4]. File: domain-execution-control.js. runtimeAdapter receives {binding,contract,input,runtimeInvocationKey}; contract is the exact released-claim WorkContract. Controller still owns current policy/strategy resolution, attempt binding, release recheck and runtime attestation; activation cannot override HOW. Test: bb048 regression.

D3A — Recovery/dedup [AC-1,AC-2,AC-7,INV-1,INV-2,INV-3]. Files: domain-activation-source.js, domain-activation.js. scan(domain)->listEligible(domain); reconcile(exact key) rereads canonical WorkContract before claim. Immediate/periodic scans recover lost hints; concurrent scan+notify converges through existing claim/release + execution-attempt currentness. Tests: domain-activation, activation-recovery.

D3B — Domain admission [AC-3,INV-1,INV-3,INV-4,INV-5]. File: domain-activation.js. Before claim require host.domain=key.domain=WorkContract.domain. Hint contains exact key only; principal/obligation/policy/strategy/runtime come from trusted config/canonical stores. Mismatch => NOOP/REJECTED with claim=0, attempt=0, dispatch=0. Tests: domain-activation + bb047 regression.

D3C — Post-release obligation fence [AC-4,INV-8]. File: domain-activation.js. From WorkContract.requiredArtifactRefs resolve exactly one BB-052 CrossDomainObligation revision and its {subjectKey,revision}; consume an injected read-only obligationCurrentness.current(subjectKey)->{revision,status}. Observe ACTIVE before claim, release canonically, reread same subject immediately before execute. Drift/non-ACTIVE => NOOP before DomainExecutionController.execute, so attempt=0/dispatch=0. BB-052, not activation, owns canonical claim invalidation/release fencing. Barrier tests: partial-invalidation/domain-activation.

D3D — Selective invalidation [AC-8,INV-8]. File: domain-activation.js. Activation never mutates obligation/work currentness: it suppresses stale exact subjects using the D3C read-only port. BB-052 invalidation bridge owns affected Board transition + release fencing; unrelated ACTIVE obligation remains returned by scan and executable. No organization/stage reset. Tests: partial-invalidation, activation-recovery.

D4 — Backend adapter [AC-5,AC-6]. File: backend-execution-strategy.js. createBackendExecutionStrategy(...) resolves matching DomainExecutionInput, maps exact WorkContract+input -> BackendObjective, dispatches prepare+runPrepared, recovers recoverPrepared, maps APPLIED/BLOCKED/FAILED -> SUCCEEDED/BLOCKED/FAILED and output/evidence refs; no Backend->QA composite call. Tests: fe-be-parallel + Backend regression.

D5 — Frontend domain [AC-5,AC-6,INV-6,INV-7]. Files: frontend-contracts.js, frontend-completion.js, frontend-worker.js, frontend-application.js, frontend-execution-strategy.js, index.js. Define Objective/WorkOrder/Context/WorkResult; completion requires frontend.mutation/typecheck/tests; application exposes prepare/runPrepared/recoverPrepared; strategy uses only exact Frontend WorkContract+input and no Backend state. Tests: frontend-domain, fe-be-parallel.

D6A — Domain host [AC-1,AC-2,AC-7,INV-2,INV-3]. File: domain-activation-host.js. createDomainActivationHost(...) -> start/scanOnce/notify/stop. start=idempotent immediate+periodic scan; scanOnce=listEligible(domain)+allSettled(reconcile key); notify=same-domain exact-key hint; stop drains only host. No priority/nextRole/nextDomain/stage API. Tests: domain-host-autonomy, activation-recovery.

D6B — FE/BE composition [AC-5,AC-6,INV-6,INV-7]. File: domain-runtime-composition.js. Compose each host with its domain principal, DomainExecutionController, prebound adapter and the BB-052 read-only obligation-currentness port; startAll/stopAll use Promise.allSettled. No shared queue/lock/strategy switch/order. Fixture uses distinct policies/descriptors/adapters/inputs; both dispatchStarted before either completes; one adapter may fail while sibling reaches terminal. Tests: fe-be-parallel, domain-host-autonomy.

D7 — Proof matrix [AC-1..AC-8,INV-1..INV-8]. Tests: domain-activation, activation-recovery, domain-host-autonomy, frontend-domain, fe-be-parallel, partial-invalidation, bb047, bb048, npm test:agentic. Fixtures expose claimCalls/attemptCount/dispatchCount/dispatchStarted + exact refs for zero-side-effect, overlap, replay, fencing and sibling-survival assertions.
